generated_from: Rising Sun Form 10s PDF, pages listed per card
scope: Twelve named hulls that have printed Form 10 cards but no digitized full ShipDef in the current eleven-scenario set.
policy: Transcribe printed Form 10 values page by page; same-class cards share one identical class profile where the task requires it. Hiei is a documented individual-profile exception: its card uses p39 (4 x 12.7cm, Area AA 0.8), while Kirishima keeps p40 (8 x 12.7cm, Area AA 1.6); p40 is a comparison only for Hiei. Printed conflicts and ambiguous fields are recorded in unresolved rather than guessed. No Rust ShipDef, campaign period profile, catalog, or source PDF was modified.

unresolved.detail: The supplied Emperor's Fleet hints 52-54, 61 and 58 resolve to merchant/auxiliary entries, not the target warships: p52-54 = A-49 Ukishima Maru, A-50 Fujisan Maru, A-51 Ashizuri; p61 = A-58 Nagara Maru; p58 = A-55 Akatsuki Maru. Actual class pages used: p8 (A-5) Kongo, p22 (A-19) Nagara, p28 (A-25) Asashio, p30 (A-27) Hatsuharu/Akatsuki. No merchant data was used.
American Fleets p10 (A-7) is the canceled 1920s South Dakota (BB-49) class, not the 1942 South Dakota class. The 1942 class is on p7-8 (A-4/A-5), which was used.

Hiei is now a separate individual profile from Form 10 p39: 2 twin Type 89 12.7cm/40 mounts (4 guns), Area AA (2)2 / 0.8. Kirishima remains on p40: 4 twin mounts (8 guns), Area AA (2)4 / 1.6. Emperor's Fleet p8 also says Hiei received only (2)2, Area AA 0.8. This deliberately does not share Kongo-class 12.7cm stats between the two cards; p40 is retained only as the same-class comparison.

Form 10 p39/p40 print Light AA (1)4 Vickers 40mm, 8 25mm, 8 13.2mm, 2.2; Emperor's Fleet p8 prints (2)2 25mm, (4)2 13.2mm, 1.0. Form 10 is retained. The two Kongo cards now keep their own main-gun marks: Hiei p39 Vickers Pattern 'A' 14in/45, Kirishima p40 41st Yr Type 36cm/45; the shell rows are identical.

Asagumo p116 (Oct-Nov 42) prints two twin 12.7cm/50 mounts (4 guns), Area AA (2)2 / 0.4, and 10 25mm. p117 (Apr-May 42), p118 (Dec 1941) and Emperor's Fleet p28 print three twin mounts (6 guns) and 4 25mm. The p116 fit is retained for this card; no attempt is made to reconcile why Asagumo alone lost a turret in the Oct-Nov 42 page.

Form 10 p77 prints Gunnery Standard IV and no 8cm/40 secondary row; Emperor's Fleet p22 prints Gunnery Standard III and P/S(1)2 3rd Yr Type 8cm/40. The annex's own 1932-37 note says the 8cm guns were replaced, so the Dec 41 Form 10 fit is retained. Form 10 light AA is 4 25mm + 4 13.2mm + 2 7.7mm, 0.8; annex summarizes 2x2 25mm, 0.8.
Form 10 p247 prints Gunnery Standard IV; American Fleets p16 prints III with a 1936 note 'Gunnery Standard IV'. The May 42 Form 10 IV is retained.

Portland p247's third 8in/55 row is printed 'Fwd (3) ... //1 Aft Main Battery Director'. The third turret is aft. gun_mounts records F,F,A and gun_mounts_verbatim retains the printed 'Fwd' label; no other stat was changed.

Walke p309 prints the 5in/38 COM extreme row as 25.9 kyds, 2/2, 11 DP, while SpCOM extreme is 14.7 kyds and the class's normal 5in/38 extreme is about 18 kyds. The value is retained verbatim as printed; no correction was made.

Form 10 p233 prints 9 20mm and 12 .50 cal, Lt AA 3.5 for the 1943 fit. Home Fleet p32's 1943 remark says aircraft/catapult removed, (1)4 20mm added, Type 273 fitted, Lt AA 3.5. The Form 10 battery is retained verbatim.

Yugure uses the Mar-Apr 42 page p145 for the November 1942 Guadalcanal I use, not the Jun 43 page p144. The two pages conflict: p145 prints 5 x 12.7cm/50 (Fwd 2, P&S 1, Aft 2), Area AA (2)2, (1)1 / 0.6, and 2 x 13mm / 0.1; p144 prints 4 x 12.7cm/50 (Fwd 2, Aft 2), Area AA (2)2 / 0.4, and 4 x 25mm + 2 x 13mm / 0.6. p145 is used verbatim; p144 remains the later alternative.

No dedicated 1942 Hiei/Kirishima Form 10 exists in the requested range; p39/p40 are both Dec 1941. p37/p38 are Haruna and p41 is Kongo Aug 42, so they were not used. Hiei and Kirishima now have separate Dec 1941 profiles (p39 and p40 respectively), with their printed 12.7cm difference preserved.
The Form 10 pages do not print hull numbers. All twelve cards keep hull_number null; no hull number was inferred from external knowledge.

data/ships/playable-cards.json records the Leander identity's class_label as '哈津斯级' (Hawkins). Form 10 p233 and Home Fleet p32 identify the hull as Leander class. This package uses Leander; the crosswalk label is left untouched.
